The Jungle Inferno Campaign might be over, but you can still access the contracts! Activating the Jungle Inferno Contracts Pass grants a Jungle Inferno ConTracker that gives access to Jungle Inferno contracts, tracks your progress, and can be equipped in-game!

You do not need this pass if you already have access to the Jungle Inferno contracts.
